$comment: Agent Economy Health Index input cohorts. Confidence tiers are explicit; nothing here is presented as ground truth.

known.label: Known agent accounts
known.note: Intentionally empty: no mainnet agent registry/contract was verified on 2026-11-12. Add only accounts with a cited registry and a real view_account probe.

heuristic.label: Heuristic agent-like accounts
heuristic.method: Bounded recent-block scan via https://mainnet.neardata.xyz/v0/block/{height} (free). Select accounts that call known agent/Intents contracts OR exhibit bot-like cadence with restricted function-call keys.

fleet.label: Sentinel Fleet (testnet, fully real)
signals: agent_count: nft_supply_for_owner enumeration over all minted Sentinels via the deployed NFT contract
publish_cadence: snapshot commitments from latest_snapshot / snapshots views, keyed by agent_account
liveness: share of agents that published within the last 2 rounds
fleet.note: Before deployment, fleet signals are computed locally from the runtime keystore; the snapshot labels the mode.
